items.quote: A digital twin is not a copied mind. It is a bounded, testable model of how someone is likely to respond in specific situations.
items.statement: A digital twin is not a copied mind. It is a bounded, testable model of how someone is likely to respond in specific situations.

items.quote: We broke each interaction into three parts: 👉🏼 Observation - What happened so far?
items.statement: We broke each interaction into three parts: observation, decision, and behaviour.

items.quote: One pattern stood out - The agenda was fixed, but the depth was adaptive.
items.statement: The agenda was fixed, but the depth was adaptive.

items.quote: We used DeepEval’s Conversation Simulator to place these learners in different contexts and interact with the trainer model,
items.statement: They used DeepEval’s Conversation Simulator to test learner interactions.

items.quote: A “conversation quality” score was not enough. We separated: 👉🏼 Learner fidelity — Did the learner stay true to its persona?
items.statement: A 'conversation quality' score was not enough; fidelity must be separated into learner, decision, and behavior fidelity.

items.quote: We did not just synthesize training data. We created a repeatable way to observe, challenge and improve a bounded model of trainer behaviour.
items.statement: Created a repeatable way to observe, challenge and improve a bounded model of trainer behaviour.

items.quote: To model an expert, do not study only the expert. Model the people and situations that cause their judgment to appear.
items.statement: To model an expert, do not study only the expert. Model the people and situations that cause their judgment to appear.

overview: The post discusses modeling trainer responses based on learner interaction data, emphasizing fidelity in simulations.
